name: dep-docs
description: Dependency documentation search — find and query API docs for Rust crates and Python libraries with hybrid search (semantic + BM25 + reranking). Auto-indexes on first query.

search.description: Search for a library by name. Returns matching crates and Python packages with snippet counts.

get_doc.description: Query documentation for a specific library. Returns relevant API docs, code examples, and type signatures via hybrid search with reranking. Auto-indexes the library on first query.

query.description: What to look up — be specific (e.g. 'derive macro for serialization', 'spawn async task', 'DataFrame filter rows')
